chunks: And no friend inquires after friend
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when friends do not inquire after each other in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Ma'arij (68:39) underscores the ultimate isolation of the soul, where even the deepest worldly bonds dissolve as each individual bears the full weight of their own deeds. It serves as a profound reminder that spiritual proximity does not guarantee shared salvation, emphasizing the necessity of personal piety over social affiliation.
